title: SWF: FileAttributes tag (tag 69)
description: SWF v8+ requires a FileAttributes tag (tag 69) as the very first tag after the SWF header. Without it, Ruffle may treat the SWF as v7. FileAttributes body is a 4-byte flags uint32: bit 0 = UseNetwork (0), bit 3 = HasMetadata (0), bit 4 = ActionScript3 (0 for v8). Emit FileAttributes immediately after the SWF header bytes in packages/swf/src/compile.ts, before SetBackgroundColor. Add a unit test verifying the first tag in the SWF output is tag 69.
